markdown.description: Markdown text — a nominal string (lowers to a nominal over string).

Memory.description: Memory — a unit of arbitrary knowledge. Plain memories exist and the Constraint/Evaluation/Conformance packs refine subtypes. `title`/`status` are the named-content labels; `body` is Markdown and MAY be empty.

Constraint.description: Constraint — an obligation expressed as a Memory. Abstract: only the concrete subtypes below are instantiated (creation requires a concrete Type; a read may select the family through the abstract name).

Policy.description: Policy — an independently maintained rule (e.g. a data-handling policy).

Requirement.description: Requirement — a necessary condition, often a defining child of a Specification.

Scenario.description: Scenario — an expected-behaviour case, often a defining child of a Specification.

Specification.description: Specification — a composite Constraint decomposed into defining Requirements and Scenarios.

References.description: References — a context pointer from a Bead to a useful resource. UNOWNED: a write revises neither endpoint. The canonical "this bead refers to that one".

SupersededBy.description: SupersededBy — normative succession: OLD (source) has been replaced by NEW (target); readers should follow NEW for current guidance. OWNED by OLD: recording it revises OLD, not NEW. Both endpoints are distinct Memory identities.

Requires.description: Requires — a necessary-dependency Link between two Constraints: SOURCE's obligations include TARGET, which is maintained independently. OWNED by SOURCE. Stating the dependency neither executes either Constraint nor proves satisfaction.

Defines.description: Defines — PARENT (source) decomposes into CHILD (target) as a defining part; a refinement of `Requires` (a defining dependency is a necessary one). OWNED by PARENT. Matches `Specification defines Requirement|Scenario`.

SubjectTo.description: SubjectTo — a declaration that SUBJECT (source) is governed by CONSTRAINT (target). SOURCE may be any Bead whose installed Type and writer support ownership of this Link; the target is a Constraint. OWNED by SUBJECT (under its installed ownership declaration).

Evaluation.description: Evaluation — an assessment over a NONEMPTY group of subject resources.

Conformance.description: Conformance — a reified CLAIM with its own identity and provenance (a bead, not a Link). Abstract: only the concrete subtypes below are instantiated. `constraint` is what it claims about; `evaluation` is the owning assessment (which names the subjects).

Addresses.description: Addresses — the Evaluation engages the Constraint (claim of relevance, not yet a verdict).

Satisfies.description: Satisfies — the Evaluation finds the Constraint satisfied.

Violates.description: Violates — the Evaluation finds the Constraint violated.
